headline: Stlican Shelf and Callahan's Passage See Fresh Fighting
war_summary: Since the last bulletin, Stlican Shelf has not slackened: ten strategic-base events in the two hours before cutoff, and forty-four on the day, with The Pale House and Vulpine Watch the busiest points. Callahan's Passage, quieter in the previous edition, has returned to the board with three fresh events in two hours and five in six; The Latch has changed hands again as the leading point. Weathered Expanse, though without a base event in the final two hours, still posted five in six and twenty in the day, all at Spirit Watch, with casualties climbing sharply. Fishermans Row, which sprang up in the earlier bulletin, cooled in the last two hours after six six-hour events centered on Arcadia and Eidolo. MarbanHollow and Stonecradle continue to see slow action at Mox and The Long Fast. DeadLands, formerly the heaviest front, has had no strategic-base event in six hours despite continuing heavy casualties. No victory has been declared.
